purpose: Parameter-free geometric interpolation baselines (bilinear, bicubic) for the NPJ Climate and Atmospheric Science manuscript. Evaluated ONLY on the final 670 of 3,350 states; no calibration is involved.
frozen_conditions: No interpolation parameter is fitted on any period.
No algorithm, boundary mode, coordinate alignment, or implementation choice may be changed after reading evaluation scores.
Ugly or favourable results are NOT grounds for removal or adjustment; both methods are retained regardless of outcome.

no_leakage: No d05 data is read in the baseline prediction path (U10_d05, V10_d05, HGT_d05, AWS are excluded until evaluation).
No scaler or normalization is applied; raw physical U10/V10 in m s-1 are used.
No DEM, no target statistics, no clipping, no smoothing, no test-dependent choices.

interpolation_contract.input: native 6x6 parent field extracted as d02_t[::27, ::27] (u and v separately)
interpolation_contract.coordinate_mapping: align_corners=False maps x_out -> x_in = (x_out + 0.5) * 6/162 - 0.5; at fine index 13 + 27k this equals exactly k, so the 6 parent-cell centres map exactly to the corresponding parent-cell centres of the 162-grid
interpolation_contract.component_order: U and V are interpolated separately; scalar speed s = sqrt(u^2 + v^2) is computed only after interpolation (never by interpolating scalar speed)
interpolation_contract.edge_behaviour: The fixed edge-value extension implied by PyTorch align_corners=False is used outside the outermost parent-cell centres. No alternative extrapolation scheme may be substituted after evaluation.

legacy_artifacts.stored_bicubic_align_corners_True: legacy provenance reproduction only (old align_corners=True pipeline); NOT a scientific baseline
legacy_artifacts.stored_bilinear_unreproducible: unreproducible provenance (max deviation 0.5834 m/s under all standard variants); NOT used at all

representative_state.selection_rule: The evaluation state whose d02 domain-mean wind speed, defined as (1/36) sum_p |U_p(t)| over the 36 parent-cell vectors, is closest to the median of that quantity over the 670 evaluation states; ties resolved to the earliest chronological state.
representative_state.selection_uses: d02 only (no d05, no interpolation output, no terrain, no visual inspection)

per_state_per_cell.delta_scalar_I: s_bar_I - |U_p|  (must equal delta_dyn_I + J_I to float32 tolerance)
per_state_per_cell.S_I: block std of interpolated scalar speed (within-parent spread)

estimands_contract.period_mean: means over the 670 evaluation states per parent cell (36 cells)
estimands_contract.all_record_scalar_speed_rmse: RMSE over p=36, t=670 -> N=24,120 cell-time records of s_bar_pred vs d05 parent-cell mean scalar speed; NEVER a 162x162 pixel-wise field RMSE
estimands_contract.terrain_scalar_reconstruction: s_hat_{p,t} = |U_p(t)| + mu_hat_delta_p, compared against d05 parent-cell mean scalar speed

vector_preservation.delta_dyn_domain_mean_I: reported as signed mean; NO recovery ratio is defined for delta_dyn (reference -0.004 m/s too close to zero)

recovery_ratios.definition: Q_X_I = domain-mean(period-mean(interp moment X)) / domain-mean(period-mean(reference moment X)); may exceed 1 (over-recovery)
recovery_ratios.terrain_excluded: Terrain closures do NOT report Q_J (the scalar equation predicts delta_scalar, not J).
recovery_ratios.terminology: Journal-visible text uses 'moment recovery' / 'recovery of the missing moments'; never 'XX% of the missing information was recovered'.

bootstrap_contract.design: Moving-block paired bootstrap, 2000 replicates, block lengths 60/120/240 min, seed 20260807, identical resampled time blocks for ALL methods.
bootstrap_contract.time_varying: Interpolation predictions are time-varying (670 x 36 per method). For each replicate the block-mean prediction is recomputed as mu_hat^{I,*}_p = (1/N*) sum_{t in T*} y_hat^I_{p,t}; the reference is re-averaged over the same blocks. Terrain/global/persistence remain static period-mean predictors.
bootstrap_contract.frozen_reference: The original 5 pairs (terrain-global, terrain-persistence, joint-global, joint-persistence, joint-exposure) from the sealed evaluation are read as a frozen comparison; old a5_paired_bootstrap.py and old paired_bootstrap.csv are NOT modified.

boundary_sensitivity.design: Full 6x6 = 36 cells vs inner 4x4 = 16 cells; compare Q_delta, Q_J, Q_S and RMSE for both interpolation methods.
boundary_sensitivity.role: Diagnostic only; it does NOT change the primary contract. Consistent -> brief report; divergent -> honest discussion of interpolation boundary sensitivity.

synthetic_qa: Constant field: bilinear and bicubic must preserve the constant exactly (machine precision)
Linear plane: bilinear must recover the linear gradient within the parent-centre convex hull
Parent-centre alignment: u_f(13 + 27k) = u_p(k) at machine precision (asserted)
Edge behaviour: outer half-parent-cell region follows fixed edge-value extension; verified, no substitution afterwards
stop_conditions: raw hashes / sealed holdout cannot be verified
test target leakage into the interpolation pipeline
